Getting started

Installation

Install Kite globally for normal use, or activate a local checkout while developing the CLI and its templates.

Dart SDK 3.8+Flutter project required for generation

Install from pub.dev

Activate the published package globally:

dart pub global activate kite

Confirm that the executable is available:

kite --version
kite --help
kite templates

Activate a local checkout

Use path activation while changing Kite source or templates:

git clone https://github.com/orkitt/kite.git
cd kite
dart pub get
dart pub global activate --source path .
i
Local development behavior

A path-activated executable may rebuild when its package source changes. That is expected while developing Kite.

Fix “command not found”

Dart global executables are placed in your pub cache. Add that directory to your shell path.

macOS and Linux using Zsh

echo 'export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin"' >> ~/.zshrc
source ~/.zshrc
which kite

Bash

echo 'export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.pub-cache/bin"' >> ~/.bashrc
source ~/.bashrc
which kite

You can also run the package without editing your path:

dart pub global run kite:kite --version

Validate your environment

Inside a Flutter project, run:

kite doctor

The doctor checks the Dart runtime, Flutter executable, current Flutter project, Kite project manifest, and bundled template registry.

Update or remove Kite

# Refresh the published package
dart pub global activate kite

# Remove it
dart pub global deactivate kite
